title: CLI: Improve yarn 1 vs Berry detection and log package manager during init
body:
- [x] Fix yarn 1 version detection regex (`/^1\./`)
- [x] Add Berry detection via `packageManager` field in `package.json`
- [x] Add Berry detection via `.yarnrc.yml` presence
- [x] Log package manager during `sb init`
- [x] Add unit tests for new detection logic
- [x] Apply comment suggestion from @Sidnioulz (improved inline comment wording)
- [x] Compute `getProjectRoot()` once in `getYarnVersion()` and pass result to helper functions to avoid repeated filesystem traversals

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Improved Yarn detection: now considers package.json's packageManager and presence of Yarn Berry config in ancestor folders in addition to yarn --version, yielding more accurate Yarn 1/2/Berry identification.

* **New Features**
  * The selected package manager is now logged during initialization with a friendly label.

* **Tests**
  * Added extensive tests covering upward package.json walking, Yarn Berry config scenarios, and various Yarn version/reporting edge cases.

comments.body: `getYarnVersion()` now does additional filesystem lookups (nearest `package.json` + `.yarnrc.yml`) and both helper functions call `getProjectRoot()` internally. Since `getProjectRoot()` is already computed for lockfile detection, consider passing the resolved `root` into these helpers (or computing it once in `getYarnVersion`) to avoid repeated upward traversals and synchronous IO on every package-manager detection run.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Suggests a concrete refactor: pass the resolved root into helper functions or compute it once to avoid repeated filesystem traversals and redundant synchronous IO.

comments.author: coderabbitai
comments.body:
_⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🟠 Major_

**Keep searching ancestor `package.json` files until one actually declares `packageManager`.**

`find.up('package.json')` stops at the first match. If a workspace package has its own `package.json` but no local `packageManager`, this helper returns `undefined` instead of using the repo-root `packageManager: yarn@...` signal, so Berry detection still falls through to `.yarnrc.yml` / `yarn --version` and can be misclassified as Yarn Classic.

<details>
<summary>🤖 Prompt for AI Agents</summary>

```
Verify each finding against the current code and only fix it if needed.

In `@code/core/src/common/js-package-manager/JsPackageManagerFactory.ts` around
lines 257 - 277, getYarnVersionFromPackageJson currently stops at the first
package.json found (using find.up) even if that file lacks a packageManager
field; change it to walk upward from the provided cwd (or project root fallback
from getProjectRoot()) to the repository root and check every package.json until
one declares packageManager. Concretely, in getYarnVersionFromPackageJson: start
at cwd (or getProjectRoot()), loop up directories until reaching the project
root, at each directory check for package.json (e.g., using find.up or
fs.existsSync/readFileSync), parse and inspect content.packageManager, and
return 1 or 2 when a matching "yarn@X." is found; only return undefined after
the loop completes. Keep the same error handling (try/catch around JSON.parse)
and continue up on missing or unparsable package.json files.
```

</details>
